title: SMB2: Improve Error Response handling
description:
[MS-SMB2] says that ErrorContextCount MUST be set to 0 for SMB dialects
other than 3.1.1 (3.1.0, which is deprecated and not mentioned in the
spec anymore, was similar to 3.1.1). If we know the conversation dialect[1]
and it's less than 3.1.0, add an expert info and set the count to 0, similar
to the handling of the ContextCount in NegotiateProtocol.

Also, starting with revision 60, the ErrorData is allowed to be missing
when the ByteCount field is zero, instead of servers including one byte
of uninitialized data that clients ignored, so if the ByteCount is zero
only set it to 1 if there's remaining data in the TVB.

Reduce the level of some of the ExpertInfos to Protocol/Warn from
Malformed/Error. A reserved byte that is nonzero when it's supposed to
be zero but is otherwise ignored doesn't warrant Malformed/Error.

Fix #21579

1 - We probably should have some kind of enum preference for the default
SMB dialect for captures where the Negotiate Protocol Response is absent.

commits_data.message:
SMB2: Improve Error Response handling

[MS-SMB2] says that ErrorContextCount MUST be set to 0 for SMB dialects
other than 3.1.1 (3.1.0, which is deprecated and not mentioned in the
spec anymore, was similar to 3.1.1). If we know the conversation dialect[1]
and it's less than 3.1.0, add an expert info and set the count to 0, similar
to the handling of the ContextCount in NegotiateProtocol.

Also, starting with revision 60, the ErrorData is allowed to be missing
when the ByteCount field is zero, instead of servers including one byte
of uninitialized data that clients ignored, so if the ByteCount is zero
only set it to 1 if there's remaining data in the TVB.

Reduce the level of some of the ExpertInfos to Protocol/Warn from
Malformed/Error. A reserved byte that is nonzero when it's supposed to
be zero but is otherwise ignored doesn't warrant Malformed/Error.

Fix #21579

1 - We probably should have some kind of enum preference for the default
SMB dialect for captures where the Negotiate Protocol Response is absent.
